scope_statement: Catalog-level enumeration covers all 36 datamarts and separately records the six glossaries listed on the official UNdata catalog on 2026-08-18. Energy Statistics and Greenhouse Gas Inventory Data are additionally profiled through resources, SDMX data structures, data elements, research-matchable variables, and constructs. Other datamarts remain catalog-identity records.

layer_5_details.notes: 5A and 5B cover the Energy Statistics and Greenhouse Gas Inventory SDMX structures only; they do not enumerate the other 34 datamarts.

enumeration.method: Parsed all ordered DataMart blocks on the official UNdata Sources page and verified the dataset/glossary boundary.
enumeration.notes: 36 datamarts are represented as Dataset records; six glossaries are recorded as a separate catalog resource. The live SDMX dataflow endpoint exposed 15 dataflows, so API coverage must not be equated with catalog coverage.

blockers.notes: Documented observation data queries timed out or returned HTTP 500 across live probes on 2026-08-18, while metadata and structure endpoints remained operational.
Thirty-four datamarts still require structure/codebook and variable-level profiling; catalog identity is not variable completeness.

scope_statement: Representative six-layer chain limited to World Development Indicators, its official catalog and API resources, the SP.POP.TOTL variable, and the Population size construct.

enumeration.method: Manual representative-chain selection from the official WDI catalog, documentation, and Indicators API metadata.
enumeration.notes: This profile does not enumerate the full World Bank Data catalog or all WDI indicators.
